text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I visited the library with 
Biwa Hayahide—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How troublesome. I can't find the textbook 
I'm looking for. And since there's no 
checkout history, that means...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that book... so it was with you, Kris 
S? I was just looking for it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's no rush, so just pass it along to 
me whenever you finish reading.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
About that...—I apologize. I'm sorry, 
but... it looks like I'll be late.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
This textbook... The Japanese is 
difficult. There are... too many parts 
that I do not understand.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if that's the case, allow me to 
explain. Reading it together helps us out 
too, after all. Right, Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, what do you think, if Kris S is up 
for it?

Yeah, how about it if Kris S is okay with 
it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...That would be a great help. Right 
now... I'm stuck right here...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Biwa Hayahide read through the 
book together with Symboli Kris S, adding 
explanations along the way.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Calculations show that with this method, 
we wouldn't achieve enough speed for the 
amount of energy consumed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I see......――Then what about this?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It is read as "dissipative 
micro-perturbation." It refers to an 
indeterminate factor in turbulent flow.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're right, don't just understand it 
through words, try actually picturing it 
in your mind.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The flowing air, the gusting wind. They 
are fluid, chaotic phenomena.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It is impossible to predict or control 
accurately, and factoring it into running 
calculations only introduces error."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Truly turbulent air currents! At times 
blocking the path, at other times becoming 
a tailwind!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"What matters are robust legs and hips 
that aren't easily swayed by airflow!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Dissipative microscopic perturbation... 
Memorized, understood. Amazing... That was 
very clear.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's good to hear.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I... don't have siblings. So...—I don't 
know what that feels like.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
But now... having an older sister like 
you. I think... it's reassuring.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're just like a real big sister.
Yeah, you're just like a real big sister.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha. Not to boast, but I've been a big 
sister for quite a long time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When we were little, just like this, I 
used to teach Brian how to read books.

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"—Listen, Brian. Don't slack off like the 
youngest of the 'Three Little Pigs.'"

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If you work hard and stay serious, you'll 
run faster. Master the basics, and you 
will grow.

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"On the other hand, if you keep slacking 
off... The big bad wolf will gobble you 
up~~! Gwaaargh~~!"

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
Kyahahaha! That tickles! Ahahaha, Sis, 
stooop~~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back. Thanks to Brian, I still 
haven't shaken the habit of fussing over 
people."
choice_data_list: She was such a kind big sister, huh.

She was such a kind big sister, wasn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's a misleading way to put it, 
Trainer-kun. I'm still kind even now, 
aren't I? Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...Must be nice. Having an older sister 
like you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to rely on me whenever you wish, 
then. I certainly don't mind being leaned 
on!
choice_data_list:
When Hayahide wants to lean on someone, 
I'll step up.

When Hayahide wants to lean on someone, 
I'll step up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to rely on me whenever you wish, 
then. I certainly don't mind being leaned 
on!
choice_data_list:
When Hayahide wants to lean on someone, 
I'll step up.

When Hayahide wants to lean on someone, 
I'll step up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I appreciate the thought, but... no. I'm 
not quite used to leaning on others, you 
see."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even if you are my Trainer-kun, you know 
you can lean on me from time to time, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Ah... I recommend it. It's very... gentle.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Come on, try calling me "Onee-chan." 
Heheheh!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha, getting the Trainer's official seal 
of approval, are we? Guess I can't afford 
to half-ass this now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'd be glad to help if there's anything I 
can do. Feel free to ask anytime, Kris 
S-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I will ask again. For an 
explanation... of the books I cannot read.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me. I shall make you an expert 
in Japanese!
